Name: Jediael, Son of Shimri
Summary: Son of Shimri the Tizite, one of David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:45: Son of Shimri the Tizite, one of David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jediael stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
